assignments.rationale: This occurrence defines the concept of perpendicular lines as lines forming a 90-degree angle. It is a fundamental geometric CONCEPT.

This occurrence states a theorem/condition for perpendicular lines in space using the dot product of direction vectors. Its mathematical meaning (a testable condition) differs from the basic definition. Therefore, it should be split into a separate THEOREM node.
